project.name: MSME shed: 18 m angle roof trusses on ISMB columns with knee braces, brick dado, Hosur (SIPCOT-type estate)

BRICK.standard: 230 mm nominal brick dado per HR test brief

connections.description: Pinned chord ends at the column cap. The resultant heel force is checked against the declared double-shear bolt group. The cap has a specified CJP weld to the column. Seat outline, bolt positions, rotation clearance and cap attachment fit require a dimensioned fabrication detail.
HSFG bolts pass through the selected fin plates. The schedule records the bored beam web and physical end set-out. Check any flange cope and fabrication clearances at the support.

Gusset connection region and through-plate bolt grip. The brace delivers load by its declared longitudinal CJP runs. Verify the mating frame attachment, gusset outline beyond the bolt group and fit-up with adjacent steel.
